result.rationale: The diff contains `totalPages: Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`, while `currentPage` is `Math.floor(offset/limit)+1`. If user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 100 members, limit 50), totalPages = 3 but only 2 pages exist; `showingLast` (propertyEqual currentPage/totalPages) never becomes true on the real last page, and 'next' advances to an empty phantom page. Correct formula is Math.ceil(user_count/limit). This is a verifiable off-by-one defect introduced by the new pagination code in admin-group.js.es6.
